result.description: A fictional ambient kinetic installation designed for galleries, lounges, and experiential retail spaces. The Nebula Loom uses layered LED strips, synchronized micro-motors, and projected particle effects to create a slow-moving light sculpture rather than a computing or storage product. It is sold as a decorative display system with programmable scene modes, quiet operation, and a brushed aluminum frame.
result.title: Astraforge Nebula Loom - Immersive Motion Table
result.title_description: Immersive kinetic light sculpture for ambient display environments
